posts.title: GSoC 2025 Final Report: RVV Optimization for the dav1d AV1 Decoder
posts.description: Project Overview and Goals dav1d 1 is an open-source AV1 video decoder that aims for the highest possible performance. The primary goal of this GSoC project was to optimize dav1d 's core video processing functions by implementing hand-written assembly using the RISC-V Vector (RVV) Extension .
